fusions.name: Bounding Lunge
fusions.desc: Bounds you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Startled Circle
fusions.desc: A turning cut that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises 20% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spring Disengage
fusions.desc: Springs you 5 tiles forward, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Flinch Into Riposte
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
